Commentary.Commentary: You know the revival of Test cricket is on the brink when the no.8 Test side beats the no.3 side in the world. Windies are most definitely on the up, and despite this loss, we all know England is a team that doesn't stay down for too long. The second Test in Antigua couldn't come sooner. The action begins at 1000 local (1400 GMT). You don't want to miss it, that's for sure. See you then, folks!

Man of the Match and Windies captain, Jason Holder, says it's been a good match for him personally. States that the series against Bangladesh was a tough one but he and the team have put in a lot of hard work for the past couple of months which is showing now. Is really pleased with how his team performed as a whole and credits his players for standing up and being counted. Wants to thank his parents for being his biggest supporters and also his two brothers for having his back throughout. Remains humble and says there's plenty of hard work left to be done and the key is consistency.

England captain, Joe Root, says he is bitterly disappointed with the result. Adds that there are two important games left in the series and it's imperative that they show character and fight back. Mentions that it's easy in hindsight to say what the team selection should have been, but they have to take responsibility and do better in the next Test. Stresses that they will be ready for the challenge coming ahead but takes a moment to credit the Windies team for playing exceptional cricket in all the four days.

It was always going to be a stretch for the Englishmen. Gunning down 628 was a long shot to begin with, so their best shot was to see out a draw. But two full days to bat through are more than enough to do you in, even on good batting conditions. That Windies batting performance was followed up by a clinical and disciplined bowling display. Chase was the star of the show as he picked up career-best figures of 8/60. The start was good for the visitors, but post that, it all went downhill. This is a performance to remember for a long time.

Having a lead of 212, the hosts piled the pressure on, with the skipper Jason Holder leading the charge. He had a valiant deputy in Dowrich and the duo went on to add a massive 295 runs between them. The captain scored his maiden double ton in the process while Dowrich crafted a century of his own. It doesn't need to be mentioned that the English bowlers were made to toil hard in that period. It came to the point where the home side had to declare for the innings to end and it set a target of 628 in front of the Three Lions.

A fine, fine effort from this resilient Windies side. An emphatic victory in every sense of the word. This might be their best performance in a Test match in recent times. They were right on top from the very beginning. Posted 289 on the board after winning the toss courtesy a collective batting effort, wherein all chipped in with useful knocks and then, much to everyone's surprise, blew a quality side away for just 77 runs with Roach leading the charge with his 5-wicket haul.

OUT! There it is! WINDIES WIN BY 381 RUNS AND LEAD THE SERIES 1-0! What a win, what a performance! They will be celebrating tonight. Spectacular effort from Jason Holder and his men. We are back for the final session of the game and probably this Test match too. Jos Buttler comes out, with his new partner Ben Foakes. Roston Chase to finish his remaining over. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 3 ...

What a session for the Windies. They are edging closer to an emphatic win. 4 wickets in this session - Bairstow, Root, Stokes, Ali all gone. All the bowlers bowled well in this session and kept it tight without giving away any free runs. Roston Chase was the pick of the bowlers, picking up 3 of the 4. England didn't manage to keep their heads above their shoulders and succumbed under the relentless pressure thrown by the Windies bowlers. As a result, they are staring down the barrel and this match could be over today itself. Let's see how it goes.

OUT! Moeen is a goner. Another duck for Ali. Gets a pair in this match. Short on off, the southpaw tries to cut it but gets an outside edge and the ball goes to Jason Holder at second slip. He holds on to it and Windies get another wicket just before the break just as they did before the Lunch break. Just 4 more required to wrap up this dominant performance.

Review! This looks close. Ben Stokes is given out lbw and he's taken the DRS. Maybe some bat involved. Only thing that can save him. Over to the third umpire now...
Tossed up on middle, Kept away by Stokes.

... Day 4, Session 2 ... The players are out in the middle. Jonny Bairstow is joined by his skipper Joe Root. Roston Chase will finish his pending over.

You'd have argued the session belonged to England, but that wicket of Burns right at the end would have made the Windies feel they've got the better of this morning. 23.5 overs, 78 runs and 2 wickets is the story of this session. It's been an eventful two hours for sure. Joseph got Jennings early and broke the opening stand of 85 runs. And post that, Burns continued with Bairstow to continue the work. The opener played a few risky shots, survived a few close calls but got to his fifty. Would have had a hundred too had it not been for that inspiring bowling change from skipper Holder. With about 6 minutes to go, he brought on Chase who knocked Burns' off stump over on his fifth ball. The runs don't really matter at this stage, but England still need 494 runs to win. Conversely, the hosts need 8 wickets for a victory. The second session will be a fun one. Join us on the other side of the break for all the action.

Goes right through the gate and takes the off stump. A wicket at the stroke of the break. LUNCH ON DAY 4!

Good length delivery outside off, a hint of movement away, the right-hander covers the line and lets it go.
Fuller length delivery on off, Jonny defends right under his nose.
Positions himself right behind the line and guards it out watchfully.
Landing around off and then moving away, Bairstow opens the bat face and dabs it to point.
Marginally ahead of a length, around off, blocked with a straight blade in response.
Another play and a miss! Shortish delivery outside off, Burns looks to cut this hard but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full delivery, blocked comfortably by coming forward.
Coming back in a bit from outside off, Rory thinks of playing at this at first but then withdraws his bat.
Sharp bumper! Around off, zips off the deck on this occasion, Burns looks to cut but the bounce gets too big on him.
Nicely done. Rory Burns drives this full delivery past mid off and comes back for the second without any trouble.
Outside off on a good length, the right-hander doesn't flirt with it.
Full ball outside off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! Too full and quite straight in line, all too easy for Jonny Bairstow. He leans ahead and flicks it neatly past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Bairstow defends it from within the crease.
Beaten! Back of a length outside off, moves away late. Bairstow stays back to punch it through the line but misses.
Length ball on off, Jonny Bairstow defends close to his body.
Back of a length, close to the off stump, blocked from the back foot.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Edged and FOUR! Oh, boy. Rory Burns has caught a lucky break. He's finding the gap around the slip cordon well. Back of a length around off, the opener hangs his bat out and the ball takes a thick edge. It flies behind and lands just short of Holder at second slip and goes through. If a third slip was there, he'd have been standing ahead and probably even caught that.
Length delivery on off stump, another defensive shot on offer.
Full this time, outside off, driven to covers.
Coming back in from a good length, around off, Burns comes forward and blocks it out.
Length ball on off, defended with the full face of the bat. 12 runs off the over.
FOUR! Third of the over. Similar to the previous one. Short and wide outside off, Bairstow just crashes this through point to send it across the boundary line.

In the air but safe! That fielder is just too far behind. Roach bangs it in short, it's sharp and accurate on off, takes Bairstow by surprise as the ball pops off the edge and falls safely before point.
Full delivery on the stumps, driven to mid on.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Jonny Bairstow. Not a great ball by any means, it's short and wide outside off, Bairstow just cuts this hard through point. No stopping that one.
FOUR! That's a terrific shot. Pure skill in that. It's a length ball around off, Bairstow camps back and with his brilliant wrists, flicks it through square leg to find the fence.
Kemar Roach is brought back on.
The batsman has played it to the point region. Can't get it past the fielder though.
Back of a length, around off and angling across, Rory tries to cut it late but the ball takes the bottom edge behind.
Once again, it's full and outside off, Burns drives it to mid off.
Full delivery on middle and off, pushed to mid off from the front foot.
Full delivery shaping away, around off, Burns attempts to drive but gets it off the bottom half.
Full in length, outside the line of off stump, Rory drives but finds the extra cover fielder.
Bairstow drives it back to the bowler. Dot ball to end the over.
This short of a good length delivery is punched on the up towards cover. Campbell there moves to his left, misfields, but fortunately doesn't concede a run.
Wide outside off, Jonny Bairstow doesn't fiddle with it.
Swinging back in, fuller in length, kept out from the inner half.
Beautiful timing. Leans into this full ball and just drives it through the gap in the covers for a couple.
Short and wide outside off, Rory Burns cuts it away to point, where the fielder makes a half-stop. Single taken.
Full ball angling down leg, Jonny tries flicking it but misses.

The 100 comes up for England. There's a loud cheer from certain sections of the ground. Burns stands tall and punches it square past point. It won't go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him three good runs.
Good stop from Roston Chase. Burns pulls this away in front of square leg, but Chase there dives to his left quickly and stops the ball.
Fraction straight in line, defended down in front of mid-wicket.
In the air for a bit but safe. Burns has to be a little careful here, these tempters could get him. Full and wide outside off, he drives it square and the ball falls short of point.
Fires the yorker in on the stumps, Burns somehow manages to dig it out.
Jonny Bairstow drives this full delivery to mid on. Dot ball.
Moving away from outside off, left alone.

A muted appeal which is pulled back instantly. Height being the issue which Holder and co. immediately realize. Length ball rising off the deck on middle and leg, Bairstow looks to defend but is caught high on the thigh pad.
Plants his front foot ahead and drives this full delivery to mid off.
Swinging back in from around off, full in length, Bairstow comes half-forward and defends it from the inner half back down the track.
A harmless length delivery outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Behind a length, around off, it's defended down in front of backward point from inside the crease.
Full delivery in line of the stumps, driven to mid on.
Moving away late, full on middle and off, Burns looks to defend but it goes off the outer half towards point.

FOUR! Flashed away and almost undone! Width on offer outside off, Burns just throws his bat at it and barely clears the leaping short third man fielder for a boundary. Maybe Jason Holder will feel it wise to place another catcher in that position.
Comes in first but then seams away, on a length, Bairstow shapes up for the punch as he places it through cover-point for a single.
No bounce at all. Alzarri with a length delivery outside off, Bairstow cuts and misses and it almost rolls back to the keeper.

Drinks are on the field. Windies finally have a breakthrough and this is their moment to take advantage of it. The surface isn't doing much, but there's some movement available for Holder and especially wicket-taker Joseph, who got rid of Jennings. Big hour coming up for both sides.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump. End of the over.
Plants his front foot forward to this full ball and drives it to mid off.
Short of a good length around off, kept out from the back foot.
Aiming the top of off stump with a length ball, Burns is watchful as he defends it with a straight blade.
Shaping away from a good length, outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Bouncer which is angling away, around off, Rory looks to upper cut this but misses.
Outside off, left alone.
Length ball on off stump, Bairstow is in two minds as to whether he should play at it or let it go. Plays at it eventually, but this is good bowling from Joseph.

FOUR! Too strong off his pads. Joseph serves it there and Jonny Bairstow flicks it through square leg. Brathwaite chases after it and attempts to pull it back with a slide, but is unable to. Replays confirm it.
Attacks the stumps with a full ball, Bairstow drives it to mid on.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length very close to off, it is blocked.
Good effort. Short ball around off, Burns pulls it off the middle but Roach at mid-wicket makes an excellent diving stop. Would have been a certain boundary otherwise.
This full delivery outside the line of off stump is driven to the cover fielder.
Too far outside off, no way the batsman has anything to do with it.
Too straight in line, flicked through the vacant square leg area for a couple of runs.
Some appreciable movement for the Windies skipper. Lands it around leg and it seams away. Burns is squared up a bit as he defends it down with soft hands.
Full and well outside off, driven square past point for a couple of runs.
No ball! A bit of a false start. Holder oversteps as he bowls a length ball which Burns defends.
Second change. Jason Holder brings himself on to bowl.

Wowza! Joseph is breathing fire. Welcomes Bairstow with a short ball. It's accurate and takes the batsman by surprise. He fends it awkwardly through the vacant short leg position towards mid-wicket. Maybe we'll see a close-in fielder in Alzarri's next over.
Jonny Bairstow walks in at no.3.

OUT! Edged and gone! Joseph provides the breakthrough. Seems like a wicket has fallen after ages in this Test. Bowls it full and around off, it moves away late and that does the trick. Jennings has no choice but to play at it and the edge in induced. It flies to the left of Jason Holder at second slip, who leaps to his left and takes a superb catch.
Initially shapes up to unleash the cut, but then aborts at the last second. Length ball outside off which is left alone.
Fuller in length, quite close to the off stick, defensively pushed in front of covers by Keaton.
Hurls it across, on a length, left alone by the batter.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery on middle and off and it cuts back in, Jennings stays right behind the line and defends.
First bowling change for Windies. Alzarri Joseph brought into the attack now.

FOUR! Ends the over in a fine way. Rory Burns has played that shot a couple of times before and like those two occasions, he's nailed it this time as well. Full and well outside off, it's driven through extra cover for a boundary.
Just behind a length, around off, defended solidly.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
In the channel outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.

FOUR! That's a dangerous shot. Three slips, along with a gully and to still play that requires one to be brave, to say the least. Outside off, Burns gets a little low and cuts it late right in the gap between the slip cordon and gully. It races away to the fence.
Length delivery rising off the deck a bit, no shot offered by the batsman.
Quite full outside off, Jennings drives it square but straight to point again.
Short of a good length outside off, the cut is slapped but only as far as point.
That doesn't rise at all, catches the batsman on the body. Short ball, Jennings ducks to let it go over him but that doesn't happen. Luckily, he doesn't take too much damage.
Fired full once more, further outside off, Jennings plays it off the inner half on the leg side.
Fullish in length, attacking the off stump, Keaton blocks it firmly towards cover-point. Opened the face slightly on that occasion.
Full delivery angling in on leg, Burns flicks this off the pads behind square leg and gets to the other end.
Too far outside off, left alone.

Beaten! Absolute peach. Unlucky not to have drawn the edge. It's a length delivery around off, angles in at first but then shapes away late. Jennings is forward to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge of his hanging bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
These first three balls are the ideal line for Roach to bowl. Must keep it up. Just ahead of a length around off, it goes off the outer half on the off side.
Hangs back and keeps this length ball out safely.
Full on off stump, pushed away on the off side with soft hands.
FOUR! Timed it to perfect. Sees the ball too full and well outside off, Burns just leans into the drive and caresses it past mid off. Leaves the chasing fielder with no chance to stop it.
Sharp bumper around off, going away from the batsman, Burns arches back and evades it.
Back of a length around off, it's helped fine down the leg side. Some good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Fifty for Rory Burns, his second in Test cricket. It's been a fine knock so far. Gets to the milestone with a flick through square leg for a couple of runs. He'll want to make it into a big one now.
Full length delivery and it's driven straight to the man at covers.
That wasn't far away. A good length delivery angling across the batter, Burns covers the line and lets it go.
Couldn't keep up with it. Full delivery well outside off, Jennings lets it be.
That's it. Kemar goes full and attacks the off stump, Jennings defends. No movement on this occasion, but this is the line to stick with.
Better, but needs to bring it in closer. Length ball around off, arms are shouldered.
Roach needs to make the batsman play. Too far out to make him bother. He's getting movement, but to no avail. Shouldn't waste this time. Full and wide outside off, the keeper collects eventually.
Another one outside off, left alone.
Roach continues from around the wicket and serves a length delivery outside off, Keaton doesn't bother himself with it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. End of the over.
Shot. Jennings reacts to the shortish ball outside off by rising on his toes quickly and punching it through cover-point for three runs.
Full delivery, moving away towards off from middle and leg, it's flicked away on the leg side.
Angles it across once more, on a good length again, Jennings is initially tempted to play at it but then decides to leave it alone.
Outside off on a good length, no shot offered by the batsman.
Gabriel angles across a length delivery, around off, doesn't rise as much as Jennings shoulders arms to it. Was quite close to the off stick.
Full on off, blocked out safely to end the over.
FOUR! Class. Roach overpitches on this occasion, there's room on offer outside off too, Burns just leans into the shot and drives it through the right of mid off for a boundary.
On the fuller side of things, in the channel outside off, Rory defends it with the full face.
Hurled full and wide outside off, the left-hander has nothing to do with it.

Edged and FOUR! Rory Burns is a lucky guy. Roach getting swing once again. Bowls it full and well outside off and it goes away, Burns reaches out, gets a thick edge and it flies between the slip cordon and the gully fielder for a boundary.
Full and wide outside off, movement instantly for Roach as it goes away, Rory tries to reach out to it but fails to make connection.
Kemar Roach to bowl from the other end.
First run of the morning. Burns moves inside the line and works it away into the leg side for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, Burns looks to pull but it goes off the bottom half back to the keeper on the bounce.
Targets the off stick with another length ball, angling in, defended from inside the crease.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, goes on straight, Burns comes forward and shoulders his arms to it.
The second delivery is wide outside off, left alone.
Back of a length to begin with. Burns defends it off the back foot.

We are all set for the action to begin. The Windies players make their way out to the middle. The English openers, Rory Burns and Keaton Jennings will resume their innings. Shannon Gabriel will start the proceedings. Here we go...

Welcome, everyone, to what could possibly be, barring an English miracle, the final day of this Test. Day 3 saw the conditions differ from the first two days and with that, Windies taking a hold of this match with skipper Jason Holder shining with his maiden double ton, ably supported by Shane Dowrich with a gritty century of his own. They set a massive target, well in excess of 600 for the visitors to chase, if that's even possible. Now, will the pitch play out differently or will we see the batters making merry once again? Rory Burns and Keaton Jennings saw the remainder of the third day without any trouble. However it goes, we'll surely have some fun.
... Day 4, Session 1...

We saw 18 wickets fall on Day 3 but not even one fell today. Signs of the wicket getting better? England will surely hope so. Windies on the other hand, need not panic they need to be disciplined and continue bowling the right lines. Will the Windies wrap it up on Day 4 or will we have a Day 5. Join us to find out on the 26th of January at 1000 local (1400 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

In reply, the England openers have started off really well. They have looked at relative ease and provided the perfect start for the visitors. They still have a long, long way to go and England would hope they can continue in the same manner.

England head into Day 4 with all their wickets intact. That would have surely been their first aim when they started their 4th innings and they have achieved their first goal. However, it is still the hosts who are in firm control of this game after their skipper and Dowrich added a massive 295-run unbeaten stand. The former got to his first double hundred whereas the latter scored a ton. They batted around 75 overs today and set England a massive target of 628.
Last ball of the day and Jennings leaves it as it as outside off. STUMPS ON DAY 3!
FOUR BYES! Straighter one in the rough outside off, Jennings leaves it and the ball keeps low and goes between the legs of Shane Dowrich behind for a boundary.
Flighted outside off, Jennings shoulders arms to it.
Straight outside off, Keaton leaves it.
Way outside off, Jennings offers no shot and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Pitches it in the rough outside off, Keaton leaves that one.
Starts with a tossed up delivery on off, Jennings pushes it to the fielder at point.
John Campbell to bowl the last over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On he stumps, defended.
Slower through the air on the pads, it is worked to short leg.
Fires it on off, Bruns keeps it out.
Flighted delivery and on off, KJ strokes it through covers for a single.
Flatter and on off, Jennings keeps it out.

FOUR! Classic straight drive to bring up the 50 run stand. Full on off, Burns gets on his front foot and hits it straight through the middle off his bat past the mid off fielder for a boundary. Solid start given by the openers. They have been watchful and cautious and have only gone after the bad balls.

Full pitching around leg, Burns tries to flick but misses. The ball hits him on his pads. The Windies players appeal but the umpire does not agree with them They think of the review but opt against it. It looked to be pitching outside leg to the naked eye.
Back of a length on middle and off, Burns keeps it out.
Full on middle and off, Rory blocks it off the  back foot.
On middle and leg this time, Burns flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Rory keeps it out with a back foot defence.
Short and wide cut straight to the fielder at point.
Shorter spinning away from  the batsman, Burns punches it to covers for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Shorter in length punched off the back foot on the off side for a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, Burns tries to defend it off his front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Shorter on length, defended off the back foot by Rory.
Back of a length, defended off the back foot.
Full on middle and leg, pushed to the fielder at mid on.
Fuller length delivery on middle, Jennings blocks it.
Full outside off, Keaton shoulders arms to it.
Back of a length on middle and off, Jennings defends it off his back foot.
Outside leg, Jennings tries to flick but misses. The ball hits him on the pads.
Alzarri Joseph is on now.
Flighted on middle, Rory blocks it.
Outside off, this time closer to the batsman. Rory leaves it.
Bowls it way outside off, the umpire signals it as wide.
Once again shorter outside off this time Rory's cut goes to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Short and wide, Burns cuts it square through backward point for a boundary.
Flighted on middle and off, Jennings sweeps it away and rotates the strike.
Starts with a tossed up delivery on off, the ball spins away from the batsman after pitching. Burns decides to leave it alone.
Full on off, Burns keeps it out with a front foot defense.
Good length delivery on middle and off, blocked away by Rory.
Back off a length on off, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! Uppish but gets the desired result. Short and wide around off, Burns goes for the cut but it hits high on his bat and goes to the vacant third man region for a boundary.
Fuller length outside off, Burns shoulders arms to it.
Full outside off, Rory leaves it away.
A big in-dipper but the line is wrong, it is on the pads, Burns works it to fine leg and a run is taken.
Good length and outside off, Burns lets it be.
More runs! Another short and wide delivery. Burns goes for the cut but it goes off the bottom and over the point fielder for a brace.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full and on the pads, Burns says thank you so much as he flicks it to the mid-wicket fence.
Length delivery on off, jennings pushes it to mid off for a single.
Shortish on off, Jennings hops and tries to cut but ends up chopping it to gully.
FOUR! Poor ball and it has been put away! Short and outside off, Rory slaps it through point and it races away.
Jennings this time works it with the angle through backward square leg for a single.
Angles this one into the batter, Jennings defends it out.
Third leave in a row as this one is also outside off.
Good length again but the line is outside off, Jennings shoulders arms to it.
Good length and outside off, it is left alone.
Kemar Roach is back on now.
Full and straight outside off, Jennings leaves it alone.
Full on middle and off, Jennings pushes it away to cover-point for a single.
Back of a length, Keaton defends it off his back foot.
Outside off, Jennings points his bat skywards and lets it go.
Full outside off, Keaton has no interest in that one and lets it go.
Length delivery outside off, Jennings lets that one go.
Back of a length, Burns defend it from within the crease.
FOUR! Full on middle and leg, Burns wonderfully times and places his flick through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Burns keeps it out.

Absoulete beauty. Shorter in length outside off, the ball initially comes in with the angle and goes away after pitching. Burns tries to gets his bat to it but it goes just a whisker away off his outside edge.
Back of a length on middle, Burns blocks it away off his back foot.
Ona length on off, Rory defends it off from within the crease.
Full on off, pushed to the fielder at  mid off.
Once again outside off and Keaton offers no shot to that one.
Fuller length on middle and off, Jennings keeps it out.
On the fifth stump, Keaton has no problem leaving that.
Full outside off, Jennings chooses to leave that away.
Length delivery outside off, a bit of inward movement of the pitch. Keaton leaves it.
Good length delivery on off, Rory blocks that off his back foot.
Full outside off, beats the edge of Rory's bat by just a few inches.
Back of a length on off, Burns keeps it out.
Fuller this time. Again it is outside off, Rory this time smartly leaves that one.
Close! Back of a length outside off, Jennings tries to push it away. The ball pitches and moves away from the batsman. Burns' outside edge is beaten.
Full on middle and off, Burns plays it with soft hands. It finds the outside edge and goes to the fielder at gully along the ground.
Outside off, Keaton refuses to offer any shot on this occasion.
Yorker on middle, Jennings gets his bat to it and keeps it out.
This time it is on the fourth stump line and Jennings shoulders arms to it.
Full and straight on the 5th stump line, Keaton has no problem leaving that one away.
Back of a length on off, guided to the fielder at point.
Full outside off, Keaton calmly leaves it.
Jason Holder is on.

FOUR! Crisp sound! Full on middle and leg, Burns times his flick to perfection and hits it through mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase but comes second best in the race as the ball reaches the fence. It made a beautiful noise off the bat.
Full outside off, it jumps off the pitch. Burns leaves it alone and Dowrich collects it at a nice height.
Full on middle and leg, Keaton flicks it to mid-wicket but does not time it well so just gets a single.
Full outside off, the ball moves in to the batsman after pitching but it is away from the stumps as Jennings shoulders arms to it.
Yorker outside off, Jennings tries to play that one but does not get his bat to it.
Back of a length on off, Keaton blocks it off his back foot.
Full outside off, Burns handsomely drives it straight to the fielder at cover.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Rory leaves it away.
Full on off, Jennings pushes it through mid on and gest a single.
Full and straight outside off. Trying to tempt Keaton but he calmly leaves it.
Full outside off, Keaton offers no shot to that one.
Full on off, finds the outside edge of Jennings' bat and goes to the fielder at point.
Full length delivery on off, pushed to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery on off, Rory blocks it off his front foot.
Shorter in length, Burns defends it off his back foot.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, flicked to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside leg, Burns leaves it.
Good length on off, Rory keeps it out off the front foot.
Back of a length, Keaton finishes off the over by not offering any shot to that one.
Good length delivery outside off, Jennings decides to leave that away.
Full outside off, Keaton pushes it to the fielder at gully.
Full on off, Jennings tries to defend it but gets a thick outside edge. He played it with soft hands so it goes along the ground to the third man region. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Fuller delivery outside off, a hint of movement after pitching. Jennings shoulders arms to it.
Full and straight outside off, Jennings leaves it alone.
Outside off, left alone.
A yorker now, the batsman has jammed it out.
A little too wide outside off again, left alone.
Back of a length on off, Burns stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
A little too wide outside off to make the batsman play.
Good length and on off, Jennings drops this towards covers and gets to the other end.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl from the other end.
Full outside off, Burns shoulders arms to it.

Good length delivery on off, Rory tries to defend it with soft hands but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes between teh slip and gull. But the gully fielder there does well diving to his right and stops a certain boundary.
Outside off on a length, Burns tries to cut it but misses.
Back of  a length on middle and leg, flicked to the fielder at mid-wicket.

FOUR! Not the most convincing starts but they will take it. Full length delivery on off, the ball moves slightly away after pitching. Burns goes for the front foot defense but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes through the slip cordon and to the fence for a boundary.
Starts with a full length delivery on off, Burns defends it off the front foot.
